title: Edmund and the Cipher
author: Yara Voss
blurb: Jude Voss, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the statute expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
